newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mixed Friday, with gold and silver slipping and platinum group metals firming.
COMEX August gold was called unchanged to off $0.50 from Thursday's close of $339.80 an ounce after trading from $340.10 to $338.50 on ACCESS.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted at $337.30/70 early against the London morning fix of $337.30 and Thursday's New York finish of $338.50/$339.00.
COMEX gold stocks rose 12,186 ounces Thursday to 853,331 ounces.

Gold prices remain weak on a lack of investor interest and the potential for European central bank sales, but gold has bounced several times this year from the $336.90 four-year low fix set in February.
COMEX September silver was called unchanged to down 0.50 cent from Thursday's close of $4.790 after trading at $4.725 on ACCESS.
NYMEX October platinum, now the active month, was called unchanged to up $1.00 from the previous close of $407.00, with NYMEX September palladium called unchanged to down $1.00 from $181.40 Thursday.

TOCOM platinum group prices remained firm, with short positions in palladium equivalent to about 52.55 tonnes now built up, ahead of the expected return of Russian metal supplies in late June or early July.
